correctness.rationale: Every clique of a line graph either lies in a single original-vertex star or is a triangle of three original edges. The star union has graph nerve; the relative long exact sequence naturally identifies integral H2 with the ordinary triangle-boundary kernel. The induced kernel is an intersection with a coordinate sublattice, hence primitive. For K5, exactness of the augmented simplex chain gives a free rank-4 lattice of five tetrahedral boundaries modulo one primitive relation. Missing edges force equality of coefficient coordinates on overlapping complementary three-sets, yielding the exact rank and image formula. A standalone exact mod-two enumeration of all 1024 restrictions and 120 signed permutation traces agrees.

originality.rationale: Prior ambient wedge type, general objectwise two-skeleton equivalence and five graph-theoretic octahedral complements are explicitly credited. The new precise claim is the primitive integral inclusion-image function across every induced restriction, including generators, sole relation, exact rank formula and a graph-inclusion-level no-death lattice model. Searches did not identify a directly stating source. Residual risk from naturality of the earlier general equivalence and unindexed special-case computations is acknowledged.
residual_risks: The published two-skeleton equivalence may admit a natural chain refinement making the general no-death lemma an easily derived corollary, although the local Petersen subgroup table is not published in the inspected text.
An equivalent full Petersen integral inclusion-image classification may exist under nonmatching-complex or edge-ideal terminology in unindexed literature.
Absence of a direct search hit is not a proof of worldwide novelty.

value.rationale: An ambient homotopy type alone cannot tell which induced restrictions carry individual integral classes, whether these classes survive inclusion, or how the minimum carriers generate the homology lattice. The theorem completely determines the 1024-subset rank and primitive subgroup profile for the canonical Petersen complex, identifies exactly five minimal six-vertex carriers and their unique relation, and proves a structurally motivated no-death property for an entire class of filtrations. The result is finite in its classification but has a supporting all-graphs chain theorem and is not a routine recomputation of the known ambient Betti number.
